passes.finding: Main and draft PR #7 resolve to the exact commits above; prior proposals remain proposals. Complete recursive candidate tree contains no AGENTS.md.
Workflow run metadata names candidate head, but logs prove checkout of PR synthetic merge a889ce09. Preserve both identities; do not describe this as a fresh exact-head build.

Godot import and headless smoke succeeded: model, skeleton, mappings, AnimationTree, head tracking, collision and world HUD. Prior seal records 24 joints/22 roles/head_fallback; no face morph/lip-sync claim. Physical rendering remains untested here.

Clean Play exports package cleanplay/code111 without Drive staging; Testing stages Drive models then rewrites package testing/code114. README and SOURCE_OF_TRUTH describe cleanplay, not actual testing APK. Green status across both is not payload equivalence.

Both workflows generate a fresh key each run. Same-package normal updates from other runs will fail certificate compatibility. Fixed versionCode114 also fails monotonic release planning. Existing APK is debug.

Standalone negated grep commands under set -e do not enforce rejection. Actual successful job logs show matches in doctrine/cutsceneDonorExtraction-20260925.json and doctrine/testingBuild-20260925.json, followed by GREEN. These observed matches are documentation, not proof of a runtime secret; scan scope and failure semantics both need repair.

Badging logs confirm arm64-v8a, min24,target36. Signature and zipalign verification step succeeded. ZIP alignment is not ELF PT_LOAD alignment or 16KB runtime evidence. Device OS, ABI and page size not read.

1920x1080 landscape and responsive D-pad anchors present; hidden capsule present. No safe-area handling/minimum physical hit-target enforcement in inspected HUD. Percentage anchors alone do not prove S24 FE/SM-X400 usability. Test two-finger move+camera, cutout/navigation overlap, pause/resume, rotation and return to Cathedral.

No device warning text, install error or developer-account state observed. Separate signature mismatch, Play Protect verdict, unknown-source permission, Samsung Auto Blocker and developer verification. A valid signature does not imply Google approval.

No new compile, installed-device proof, persistent-key update test or independent artifact rehash this turn. Local checkout blocked by approval-service infrastructure failure. Save this bounded audit as proposed evidence; main and stable release remain unpromoted.

proposedBuild.name: LuHm OS Universal Samsung Candidate

devices.model: Samsung SM-X400 (Galaxy Tab S10 Lite Wi-Fi)

proposedBuild.approach: One native Godot project, one pinned asset set, one ARM64 APK and one candidate identity/signing lineage for both devices. Universal means shared Samsung target, not every Android ABI.
proposedBuild.runtime: Preserve native Cathedral -> Riverwalk -> Cathedral, LumRigV2 and explicit head_fallback. Browser frontend remains a separate prototype until implemented/tested.
proposedBuild.signing: Persist one protected candidate signing key; verify expected certificate fingerprint before upload. No fallback to random signer. Release signing remains separately authorized. Never expose signing material to pull-request code.
proposedBuild.migration: Compare installed certificate first. If old disposable signer differs, in-place replacement is not supported without the old key/signing lineage. Preserve/export app data before a user-authorized candidate reinstall; never uninstall automatically. Golden package stays untouched.
pipeline: Pin exact source checkout and dependency/asset hashes.
Replace duplicate build identity rewriting with one checked build contract and one asset-ingest path.
Use explicit fail-closed runtime/manifest scans; scan errors must fail too. Keep policy text outside runtime scans.
Add a negative control proving a forbidden runtime fixture fails; do not count JSON list length as security proof.
Inspect final APK manifest permissions, SDKs, ABI, debuggable state, package/version and certificate.
Verify ZIP and all native ELF alignment; run on 16KB environment before claiming compatibility.
Run meaningful import/runtime, HUD/input and candidate upgrade tests.
Produce receipt tying source checkout, assets, signer, APK hash and run together.
proposedBuild.install: For private development, use authorized ADB installation of the same exact APK on each device, after installed-package/certificate checks. No APK self-installer or security-disabling shim.
proposedBuild.googlePath: For ongoing personal distribution, assess Android Developer Console limited distribution (up to 20 devices) and register the persistent package/certificate as applicable. This does not guarantee Play Protect acceptance or supersede Samsung device controls.
requiredReceipts: Exact new source commit + workflow run + APK hash + certificate fingerprint
Actual warning screenshot or installer error if blocked
Persistent signing custody and recovery established privately
